_status: PRE-DEPLOY feeds config only. Core contracts are NOT yet deployed on 4663 — this file records the Chainlink price-feed proxies + staleness (heartbeat) config that DeployQualyra.s.sol (_wireFeeds) must read from env vars at mainnet deploy, and that factory.setPriceFeed / setSequencerFeed enforce afterwards. Full contract addresses will be generated into deployments/4663.json from the broadcast files after deployment. No Solidity is changed by this file.
_heartbeatNote: Real Chainlink feeds on 4663 update AT LEAST every 86400s (24h) heartbeat (and immediately on the price deviation threshold). The deploy-script default FEED_HEARTBEAT is 3600 (1h) — too tight: it would mark healthy prices stale => oracle NOT-EVALUABLE => the eligibility/battle engine silently freezes (fail-safe: trading/fees/launch/buyback still work). Set every heartbeat >= 86400; 90000 is used here for margin.
_provenance: Feed proxy addresses extracted from the official Chainlink registry feeds-robinhood-mainnet.json (58 feeds). ALL 5 feeds verified read-only against the chain via eth_call (description/decimals/latestRoundData) on 2026-09-24: every feed returns decimals=8 and a fresh, sane price. See the verification block for per-feed detail. Note: feed descriptions are NOT uniform (USDG / USD, RHNVDA / USD, Robinhood AAPL / USD, RHSPY / USD) — harmless, the oracle keys feeds by address, not description.

secondaryProxies._comment: Non-SVR secondaryProxyAddress per asset (Chainlink registry). The primary proxies use 'Shared SVR' (Smart Value Recapture — mainly benefits lending/liquidation OEV). ALL 5 non-SVR proxies verified read-only 2026-09-24: decimals=8 and IDENTICAL price + updatedAt to their SVR primaries (data-equivalent). Qualyra only reads price for a market-cap threshold (no liquidations), so SVR adds no benefit here; the non-SVR proxy is the simpler default, but either set works. Pick ONE set before mainnet — do not mix.
